_comment: Built from the paper 'Religious Education Registration' form Holli provided.
Two deliberate departures from the paper:
1. The paper is one form per child. This is one form per household with a
repeating child block, because the tuition table is already priced per
family and a parent should not retype their own details per child.
2. The paper's separate 'Registration Fee form' is the returning-family
path. That is the 'renew' intent on the first step here.
Photo release wording is reproduced from the paper form. Changes are the
title: Faith Formation Registration
successTitle: Thank you. Your children are registered.
successBody: The Catechesis Coordinator will follow up about tuition and the class schedule. Watch for a copy of this form in your email.

steps.title: Getting started
steps.help: This takes about fifteen minutes. We save your progress as you go, so you can close this and come back.

fields.html: If your family is new to the parish, please also fill out the parish registration form. This form enrolls your children in faith formation. It does not register your household with the parish.
This information is used for the purposes of the Church Office only and will not be given out without consent.

steps.title: Children to enroll
steps.help: Add one for each child you are enrolling. Tuition is charged per family, not per child.

fields.html: Please note: we are unable to release a child to any person who is not listed as the custodial parent or guardian without written notification by the custodial parent or guardian.
